title: Interpretable machine learning screens electrolyte additives for zinc-ion battery anodes
summary: An interpretable ML model predicted cycle life from molecular descriptors and test conditions, and SHAP profiles clustered additives into three attribution-based categories. Representative additives absent from the training set agreed with experiment within 11%. The screened additive 2-fluoropyridine-5-carbaldehyde was predicted at 3218 h and delivered 3010 h in Zn//Zn cells (within 6.5%), and Zn//MnO2 full cells kept 96% capacity over 4000 cycles.
ai_technology: Interpretable machine learning with SHAP attribution fingerprints predicting zinc anode cycle life and screening additives
